trainers.instruction: Read the sentence and answer the question.

atoms.text: Sea otters often hold hands while they nap because it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep.

atoms.a: Which part of the sentence is a claim?
b: ++ Sea otters often hold hands while they nap
because it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep.

hint.text: A claim is a statement that something is the truth or a fact.

instruction.text: What is the purpose of the second part of the sentence?
instruction.sound: What is the purpose of the second part of the sentence?

atoms.a: Sea otters often hold hands while they nap <m-yellow>because it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep.</m-yellow>

b.sound: It gives a reason of why sea otters hold hands while sleeping.
It proves the information about Sea Otters is false.

instruction.text: Which question does a reason give the answer to? Find and select the correct question word.

atoms.a: Sea otters often hold hands while they nap <m-yellow>because it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep</m-yellow>.

end.text:
A reason answers the question why. It explains the cause or motive behind the claim.
Why do sea otters often hold hands while they nap? Because it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep.
end.sound: ssml: A reason answers the question why. It explains the cause or motive behind the claim. <break time='500ms'/>Why do sea otters often hold hands while they nap? Because it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep.

instruction.text: Select the clue word that signals there is a reason in the sentence.

hint.text: The clue word you are looking for answers the question word 'why'.

atoms.b: Sea otters often hold hands while they nap ((because)) it stops them from drifting away from their companions in their sleep.

end.text: The word 'because' always introduces a reason. Finding this clue word is helpful when you are looking for the reasons to a claim in a text.
